[State Employees Credit Union of New Mexico] UNRESOLVED MAPPING, not a change -- four SECU fee schedule lines may be mismapped. Currently: NSF Fee / Overdraft Privilege Fee (mutually exclusive per the TIS PDF's "either ... but not both" language, both currently agreeing on the same figure) feed 'overdraft_fee' (this run: $25.00); "Return Check Charge" feeds 'returned_item_fee' (this run: $10.00); "Uncollected Funds Fee" (this run: $25.00) is unmapped. Evidence the mapping may be backwards: (1) the TIS PDF states Overdraft Privilege Fee = item paid, NSF Fee = item returned -- so 'overdraft_fee' may actually belong on the NSF Fee line, not the Overdraft Privilege Fee line it's currently drawing from equally; (2) page 7's fee schedule footnotes "**NSF = ISF Fee", confirming NSF concerns items RETURNED, not paid. If confirmed, "Return Check Charge" would instead belong to 'returned_deposit_item_fee' (a deposited check that bounced, not a payment SECU itself returned) -- moving SECU from cheapest to second-most-expensive on the returned-item comparison row. Not changed pending human confirmation via SECU (800.983.7328); see data/feedback_log.yaml.

[State Employees Credit Union of New Mexico] This page states effective date '01/23/23', but the Truth-in-Savings PDF's fee schedule (page 7) states a different date '07/14/2023' -- despite that, all 8 field(s) comparable between the two documents agree on value (account_research_fee, card_replacement_fee, cashiers_check_fee, dormant_account_fee, atm_out_of_network_fee, overdraft_fee, returned_item_fee, stop_payment_fee), so the underlying fee amounts are corroborated across two independently typeset sources even though the stated dates disagree; which date is authoritative is still unresolved.

[State Employees Credit Union of New Mexico] SECU NM requires a $5.00 "Par Value of One Share" to open membership (Truth-in-Savings PDF, page 7) -- a one-time membership cost of access that none of this report's other (non-member-owned) institutions has an equivalent line for.
